_comment: The Nature Notes topic hubs (/archive/topics/), read by scripts/gen-archive.mjs and checked by scripts/check-archive-citations.mjs. Every quote is copied verbatim from one paragraph of the issue named by `issue` (its archive slug), spelling and punctuation as printed: the generator refuses to build a hub whose quote it cannot find in that issue, and the citation check re-reads the published page. No ellipses, no splicing, no paraphrase. `headlines` is a regex over the bulletin's capitalised headlines from the hub's years; `exclude` drops matches that are not about the topic (exact headline text after the masthead prefix is stripped). `headlineNoun` finishes the lede's sentence 'the bulletin's own headlines on ...', so it must describe what the filtered list actually holds. `reads` are onward links to the site's own pages.
